title: Deep-analyzer changes gated on corpus evidence
objective: Require maintained analyzer corpus cases, expected-output comparisons, representative repository/commit histories, and regression commands before deep-analysis behavior can be promoted.
source_rule: Corpus before code: no analyzer change without expected-output comparison.
allowed_evidence: expected analyzer outputs for each corpus case
representative repository shape and commit history
regression command for the analyzer suite
forbidden_actions: promoting repository, commit, architecture, or deep-analysis changes without analyzer corpus evidence
suppressing the Deep Analyzer Evidence risk bucket without co-located corpus, snapshot, fixture, or benchmark evidence
changing analyzer thresholds or classifications without expected-output comparison
posting PR comments, check runs, or Linear sync updates from this read-only evaluator run
acceptance_gates: maintained corpus or reference-set path is included
representative repository shape or commit history is described
